title: BusinessCaseType production edge composition S4g verification
requiredEvidence: Offline composition derives domain-separated hashes from the actual S4d, S4f and S6b contract files and implementation files for the identity inspector, owner verifier, token factory, Graph transport and Azure WORM REST transport; the separately bound identity snapshot attestation is produced only by the exact in-memory SnapshotIdentityInspectionPort, and the WORM target remains explicitly offline-unconfigured.

Provisioner, writer and BFF app_id values are pairwise distinct; their service_principal_object_id values are independently pairwise distinct; the complete app-ID and object-ID namespaces are disjoint.
Writer remains exactly Sites.Selected/write and BFF remains exactly Sites.Selected/read; only writer may be the business writer and token source.

Mutation state and evidence staging use exact, distinct canonical SQLite paths under a trusted local 0700 root; existing files must be regular, owner-only 0600 files with st_nlink equal to one and distinct device/inode identities; weak-mode, hardlink, symlink, synced, remote and unknown filesystems fail closed.

Azure Blob WORM REST uses owner-bound HTTPS hosts, pinned API versions, injected token and HTTP ports, GET/PUT only, bounded bodies, no redirects or retries, If-None-Match create, exact-version readback and no policy lock or delete operation.
PostgreSQL promotion/ack/retention/cleanup, broker decision, signature anchor decision, durable reconciliation, irreversible WORM lock and owner-gated live activation remain explicit blockers.

Output is exactly S4G_PRODUCTION_EDGE_COMPOSITION_VERIFIED_OFFLINE with live status BLOCKED_PENDING_CENTRAL_EVIDENCE_AND_OWNER_GATED_ACTIVATION and makes no production-readiness, durability or live-authorization claim.
Independent base...head review has no unresolved P1 or P2 findings.
invariants: Provisioner, writer and BFF remain separate by app ID, service-principal object ID and hash-bound principal evidence.
Local SQLite mutation state and evidence staging are separate single-host stores, are not central truth and cannot close a mutation.
The Azure transport can read policy evidence and create/read exact blob versions but can never mutate or lock an immutability policy.
No live Graph, Entra, SharePoint, Teams, Azure, credential-store or infrastructure action occurs.
S4G_PRODUCTION_EDGE_COMPOSITION_VERIFIED_OFFLINE is not production readiness or live authorization.
